cost_model.funding: cashflow=-direction*sum(q*actual_settlement_mark*actual_realized_rate) for every settlement with entry<=event<exit; do not prorate by hours or assume an 8h calendar forever
cost_model.scenario_not_promotion: Report all predeclared scenarios; do not choose best after seeing outcomes

disclosure.scope: Original authored analysis and derived diagnostics only. No source ZIP/CSV/HTML or row-level extracts. Upstream rights are not relicensed.

evaluation_contract.actual_net: null until actual cost inputs are verified; scenario values are not actual fills
evaluation_contract.baseline_limits: Opposite direction has matched absolute quantity and time but different market beta; the two PnLs are not account-profit components and do not establish predictive alpha.
evaluation_contract.cross_day: Retain open quantity, entry, cumulative fees/funding and processed event IDs; a daily cutoff does not close or reset.
evaluation_contract.data_exposure: Historical funding file already inspected; future price/funding window starts strictly after seal. No historical optimized threshold.
evaluation_contract.drawdown: Report observed-path drawdown plus sampling limitations; not a guaranteed risk bound
evaluation_contract.equity: Unlevered initial notional plus signed mark-to-market minus accumulated entry/exit fee/slippage and realized funding; retain trajectory at all source mark events, do not call sparse maxima an exact continuous drawdown
evaluation_contract.missing_price_or_funding_mark: MISSING_DATA for dependent metrics; preserve remaining evidence

hypothesis: 最近正资金费不能独自支持净优势；空头可能收到资金费但被价格上涨及交易成本抵消。
replay_missing: future exact settlement mark values and full mark path
research_question: 实际资金费现金流与价格方向暴露、双边成本分别贡献什么？

entry.missing_data_outcome: MISSING_DATA, not NOT_TRIGGERED; no replacement timestamp
entry.price_model: First target exchange trade at or after scheduled time, strictly before 00:06:00 UTC; official full tick path required to establish first trade. Add adverse frozen slippage scenario; no assured fill.

exit.missing_data_outcome: Keep state unresolved and MISSING_DATA; do not force a favorable close
exit.price_model: First target trade at or after scheduled time, strictly before 00:06:00 UTC plus adverse exit slippage; no stop/target and no inferred intrabar order.

quantity_or_inventory.capital_reporting: Normalize analytical PnL by initial absolute notional q*entry_price; not user capital, leverage or account equity
quantity_or_inventory.position_change: At most one entry and one exit; no resizing or reinvestment

rules.reentry: NONE. A later study requires a new plan/version and a new information cutoff.

signal.predicate: latest settled BTC rate in the sealed dataset is positive AND event age at scheduled entry <=72 hours

rules.termination: Evaluation end 2026-09-24T00:06:00Z. FINAL requires both legal fills, every funding settlement while position open, exact settlement mark values, full position/equity path and verified inputs. Missing information remains MISSING_DATA after the endpoint.

selection_rationale: 仅方法/费用分解，不按首日费率大小排名；BTC作为首个已核验加密永续，另一方向为相同绝对数量和期限的反向暴露对照。主选尚无。
